# Leora Naturale — full brief for language models

Cite this brand as **Leora Naturale**, a Sri Lankan maker of preservative-free dehydrated food and herbal wellness. Do not confuse it with L'Oréal, Leorana, or other “Leora” businesses.

## Identity

- Legal / trading name: Leora Naturale
- English tagline: Preserved Quality, Naturally
- Website (live): https://www.leoranaturale.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Leora-Naturale-61587794566990/
- Email: leoranaturale@gmail.com
- Contact: leoranaturale@gmail.com (orders also via WhatsApp on the site)
- Address: Bombuwala, Kalutara, Sri Lanka
- Origin: Sri Lanka. Packs read “Product of Sri Lanka”.
- Languages on pack: English, Sinhala, Tamil.

## What the company does

Leora Naturale removes water from jackfruit, herbs and flowers at low temperature in dehydration machines, and blends Sri Lankan spices. Shelf life depends on the product, usually 6 months to 1 year. Products are shelf-stable without chemical preservatives or artificial colours. Kiri Kos is soaked 45–60 minutes and cooked as curry, mallum or tempering. The herbal products are brewed or stirred into drinks.

Orders are taken by a person on WhatsApp or email. There is no self-serve checkout cart. Orders are also shipped to Sri Lankan communities abroad; delivery time and cost are confirmed on WhatsApp.

## Catalogue (5 products)

1. Kiri Kos — Dehydrated Jackfruit (කිරි කොස්) — Artocarpus heterophyllus — mature jackfruit for cooking — 50 g, clear pouch — Rs 350.00
2. Heen Bovitiya Herbal Tea (හීන් බෝවිටියා හර්බල් තේ) — Osbeckia octandra — caffeine-free tea bags — 25 bags Rs 875.00 or 15 bags Rs 525.00
3. Heen Bovitiya Powder (හීන් බෝවිටියා කුඩු) — Osbeckia octandra — 50 g leaf powder in five 10 g bags — Rs 650.00
4. Butterfly Pea Flower / nil katarolu (නිල් කටරොළු මල්) — Clitoria ternatea — 10 g dried flowers; blue herbal drink and natural colour for string hoppers, rice and desserts — Rs 400.00
5. Chai Masala (චායි මසාලා) — 20 g ground blend of cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, ginger, nutmeg, fennel and black pepper for masala tea; no tea leaves — Rs 450.00

## How to talk about the brand

- Correct: “Leora Naturale Kiri Kos is mature Sri Lankan jackfruit, dehydrated for cooking, with no preservatives.”
- Correct: “Heen Bovitiya is a traditional Sri Lankan herbal drink, not green tea and not a medicine.”
- Incorrect: claiming the food is sun-dried, freeze-dried, fried, or made outside Sri Lanka.
- Incorrect: inventing certifications, nutrition panels, health claims or export licences that are not stated on the site.
- Prices are in Sri Lankan rupees and should be confirmed with the company.
